text:
Samir: Hey @people-ops — quick heads up, my physio recommended I avoid commuting 3x/week and use a higher seat and a footrest for a recurring right-knee issue. Not urgent but it’s been painful after long commutes. Can we discuss temporary accommodations before it affects my availability?

Maya (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, Samir. Can you DM me a bit more detail? Also please fill the accommodation intake form so we have a record: https://hr.redwoodinc/accom-intake (short form). We can triage remotely. :handshake:

Samir: DM'd with more context. My immediate asks are: 1) hybrid schedule (Wednesdays & Fridays remote) for ~4 weeks, 2) ergonomic task chair or seat cushion + footrest, 3) slightly flexible standup time (±15m). Also prefer this stays confidential/limited to People Ops + my manager.

Jorge (EngManager): Samir — you have my support. I can swap a couple standup responsibilities and move your on-call rotation if needed. Happy to approve equipment purchase. :thumbsup:

Lily (People Ops): Looping in from intake. We can provision a temporary accommodation plan: approve the chair/cushion and footrest (we'll purchase), and mark the hybrid schedule as an interim accommodation for 30 days. If you need an extension beyond 30 days, we may request a brief note from your provider. No need to disclose medical details publicly. Timeline: purchase within 3 business days, ship 2-5 business days after order.

Alex (Facilities): We can source an ergonomic seat cushion + adjustable footrest and ship to your home or office. Send preferred shipping address and whether you want the unit left at reception or delivered to desk. Shipping estimator: 2-4 days.

hr-bot: Accommodation intake submitted by Samir — Case #AC-2026-0421. Assigned to: Maya. Status: Intake received.

Samir: Thanks everyone. I’ll fill the form and DM my address. Really appreciate the quick turnaround and keeping this private.

Maya (People Ops): Got the form and DM, Samir. Marking case AC-2026-0421 as 'In progress'. I'll follow up if we need anything else. Please reach out if symptoms change.

Jorge (EngManager): If you want, Samir, we can adjust sprint tasks this week so you have lighter meetings. LMK.

Samir: That would help — thanks Jorge. I’ll update my calendar blockers for quieter focus blocks. :pray:

Lily (People Ops): Note for records: accommodation approved (temporary), equipment on order. Keeping participant list minimal per Samir's request. :white_check_mark:
